Missing scope, incomplete reads or drift yield unknown; application-wide absence and atomicity remain unproven. Reads the exact deployed app revision, timer identity and idle/active state first; authorization must name app and timer. Accepted is not execution/completion proof; follow its read continuation and never repeat Wake for evidence. Live write proof is pending.

timers.pause/resume use native SaveAndApply after matching deployed public/native values and origins, an idle timer, no pending changes or deployments, and inherited unrelated configuration. Schedule and timeout origins are preserved. The deployment receipt is confirmed only after exact application/environment and timer state readback. Atomicity is not claimed; live write proof is pending.
